[background-block=#120d07][align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/tape-night/tapenight-head.png[/img][/align]

[align=center][b][background=#F2B95B][color=#120d07] This Saturday [/color][/background][color=#F2B95B] | [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2835001][color=#F2B95B]The Exchange[/color][/url][color=#F2B95B] | [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2833652][color=#F2B95B]The Old Culture[/color][/url][color=#F2B95B] | [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1996515][color=#F2B95B]← Back to Los Vales[/color][/url][/b][/align]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/tape-night/tape-night-1.png[/img][/align]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/tape-night/tape-night-2.png[/img][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[color=white]Every Saturday, in a garage behind a blue door, we put an old film on a tube TV and watch it together. The TV has no chip, the tape has no owner, and nobody is counting who came. It is the only screen in Los Vales that does not watch you back.[/color]

[color=white]There is no ticket. Bring food for the table, or a story for after the film. Children come free and leave last.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/tape-night/tape-night-4.png[/img][/align]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/tape-night/tape-night-5.png[/img][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#F2B95B][b]HOUSE RULES[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white][b]1.[/b][/color][color=white] Cover your Lens, or sit in the back row. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Panoptica[/color][/url][color=white] keeps a list of "people who unplug". We do not want to be on it.[/color]

[color=white][b]2.[/b][/color][color=white] No [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832746][color=#7FDBFF]Velocitas[/color][/url][color=white], no doses, no [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832550][color=#7FDBFF]Psychoverse[/color][/url][color=white] headsets. Tonight you are here.[/color]

[color=white][b]3.[/b][/color][color=white] Talk during the boring parts. That is what the boring parts are for.[/color]

[color=white][b]4.[/b][/color][color=white] If someone you do not know asks for the address, say you only came for the popcorn.[/color]

[color=#FCFE76][i]"Stay up." — written in chalk on the inside of the blue door[/i][/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/tape-night/tapenight-foot.png[/img][/align]

[/background-block]

2835001.text:
[background-block=#120d07][align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/tape-night-exchange/tapenight-head.png[/img][/align]

[align=center][b][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2835000][color=#F2B95B]This Saturday[/color][/url][color=#F2B95B] | [/color][background=#F2B95B][color=#120d07] The Exchange [/color][/background][color=#F2B95B] | [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2833652][color=#F2B95B]The Old Culture[/color][/url][color=#F2B95B] | [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1996515][color=#F2B95B]← Back to Los Vales[/color][/url][/b][/align]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/tape-night-exchange/tape-night-exchange-1.png[/img][/align]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/tape-night-exchange/tape-night-exchange-2.png[/img][/align]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/tape-night-exchange/tape-night-exchange-3.png[/img][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#F2B95B][b]HOW TO KEEP A TAPE ALIVE[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]Keep it away from heat, magnets and Lens chargers. Rewind it to the start before you store it. Play it at least once a year: a tape that is never watched forgets itself. And never, ever plug the player into the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832553][color=#7FDBFF]W-Net[/color][/url][color=white]. It does not need it, and neither do you.[/color]

[size=130][color=#F2B95B][b]THE NIGHT OF THE SIGNAL[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]Once a year every old TV in the country tunes to the same pirate channel at the same hour. Nobody knows who sends it or when it will come. When it does, every garage cinema stops the film and leaves the TV on. Last year it showed rain falling on a field in [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999863][color=#7FDBFF]Coronnel[/color][/url][color=white] for forty minutes. Nobody changed the channel.[/color]

[size=130][color=#F2B95B][b]THE FAIR OF FORGIVENESS[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]Once a year, after the last film, families sit in the garage cinemas and forgive pieces of each other’s debts: a loan from a brother, a broken promise, a bill nobody can pay. It does not change a single number at [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Lockwell[/color][/url][color=white]. It changes almost everything else.[/color]

[size=130][color=#F2B95B][b]FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white][b]Is this legal?[/b][/color][color=white] Nothing here is forbidden. It is just impossible: nothing is certified, nothing is insured, and nothing is for sale.[/color]

[color=white][b]Why can I not find you on the W-Net?[/b][/color][color=white] That is the point.[/color]

[color=white][b]Does [/b][/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF][b]Zyx[/b][/color][/url][color=white][b] have a [/b][/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832550][color=#7FDBFF][b]Psychoverse[/b][/color][/url][color=white][b] like this?[/b][/color][color=white] It is called "Retro". We have tried it. The tapes in it never wear out. That is how you know.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/tape-night-exchange/tapenight-foot.png[/img][/align]

[/background-block]

2835002.text:
[background-block=#0b1120][align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/clause-zero/clausezero-head.png[/img][/align]

[align=center][b][background=#F5C542][color=#0b1120] Buy a piece [/color][/background][color=#F5C542] | [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2835003][color=#F5C542]The Wall[/color][/url][color=#F5C542] | [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832655][color=#F5C542]The Charter[/color][/url][color=#F5C542] | [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1996515][color=#F5C542]← Back to Los Vales[/color][/url][/b][/align]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/clause-zero/clause-zero-1.png[/img][/align]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/clause-zero/clause-zero-2.png[/img][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#F5C542][b]THE CLAUSE NOBODY READ ALOUD[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]In 2028 the Republic of Los Vales could not pay its debts, and its creditors took the country instead. The [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999866][color=#7FDBFF]Debt Accord[/color][/url][color=white] they signed has a clause that was never read aloud: if the debt of 2028 is ever paid in full, the Free States are dissolved and the Republic of 2013 returns — with its president, its courts and its elections.[/color]

[color=white]In 2086 a photo of that page reached [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2830615][color=#7FDBFF]Neon Wire[/color][/url][color=white]. The next morning, a dockworker in [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2530927][color=#7FDBFF]Ferox[/color][/url][color=white] taped a coin to a wall and wrote under it: "My piece." That was the beginning.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/clause-zero/clause-zero-4.png[/img][/align]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/clause-zero/clause-zero-5.png[/img][/align]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/clause-zero/clause-zero-6.png[/img][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#F5C542][b]FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white][b]How big is the debt?[/b][/color][color=white] 612 billion credits in 2028. With sixty years of interest, nobody will tell us the number. We estimate thirty-eight trillion.[/color]

[color=white][b]Why does the counter go down?[/b][/color][color=white] Every time we get close, the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Meridian Trust[/color][/url][color=white] raises the interest. We raise the goal the same afternoon.[/color]

[color=white][b]Is it legal?[/b][/color][color=white] Paying a debt is always legal. That is the one thing in this country nobody can forbid.[/color]

[color=white][b]What if we never finish?[/b][/color][color=white] Then we will have found out what the debt was for.[/color]

[color=#FCFE76][i]"Every nation has a price." — Meridian Trust, notice of interest adjustment, November 2088[/i][/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/clause-zero/clausezero-foot.png[/img][/align]

[/background-block]

[background-block=#0b1120][align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/clause-zero-wall/clausezero-head.png[/img][/align]

[align=center][b][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2835002][color=#F5C542]Buy a piece[/color][/url][color=#F5C542] | [/color][background=#F5C542][color=#0b1120] The Wall [/color][/background][color=#F5C542] | [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832655][color=#F5C542]The Charter[/color][/url][color=#F5C542] | [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1996515][color=#F5C542]← Back to Los Vales[/color][/url][/b][/align]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/clause-zero-wall/clause-zero-wall-1.png[/img][/align]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/clause-zero-wall/clause-zero-wall-2.png[/img][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[color=white]There is a Wall in every city now: a stretch of concrete where people tape a coin and a note. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Lockwell[/color][/url][color=white] trucks drive past them every day and never stop. Here are some of the notes, copied before the rain took them.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/clause-zero-wall/clause-zero-wall-4-1.png[/img][/align]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/clause-zero-wall/clause-zero-wall-4-2.png[/img][/align]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/clause-zero-wall/clause-zero-wall-4-3.png[/img][/align]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/clause-zero-wall/clause-zero-wall-4-4.png[/img][/align]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/clause-zero-wall/clause-zero-wall-4-5.png[/img][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#F5C542][b]WHAT THEY SAY ABOUT US[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]The [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF][b]LVN[/b][/color][/url][color=white] calls the Clause a forgery and [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832726][color=#7FDBFF]the Wall[/color][/url][color=white] "vandalism with good intentions". The [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF][b]Meridian Trust[/b][/color][/url][color=white] raises the interest every time the counter moves. The [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999866][color=#7FDBFF][b]Cabinet[/b][/color][/url][color=white] has never mentioned us, which is how we know they read this page.[/color]

[size=130][color=#F5C542][b]WHO PAYS FOR ALL THIS?[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]Citizens pay for the debt. Nobody pays us: every member is a volunteer. Our lawyers work for free, and they are very good. We have never asked why.[/color]

[color=#FCFE76][i]"My piece." — the first note on the first Wall, [/i][/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2530927][color=#7FDBFF][i]Ferox[/i][/color][/url][color=#FCFE76][i], 2086[/i][/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/clause-zero-wall/clausezero-foot.png[/img][/align]

[/background-block]
